## Research Questions

> 3–6 primary questions. Each must map to a method and a decision.

| # | Question | Method | Rationale |
|---|---------|--------|-----------|
| 1 | [Question] | [Method] | [Why this method for this question] |

| 3 | [Question] | [Method] | [Why this method for this question] |

**Method key:**
- Contextual inquiry — understanding real workflows in context
- Semi-structured interview — motivations, pain, and mental models
- Survey — validating frequency or scale of a problem
- Usability test — evaluating a specific design or prototype
- Diary study — longitudinal or low-frequency behaviors
- Competitive analysis — understanding the market landscape
